audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer says diff EVEN (5.5/10) with all 7 phases.side = 'Skill', but content win[] reads Brand for phases 0-5 and Zilean for phase 6 — and the packet's levelChart (Brand x6, Zilean x1) confirms the content layer, not the full layer.
audit.why: This is exactly the two-layers-disagree defect the audit brief calls out: a reader sees 'Skill/EVEN' at the top and 'Brand favored' in the level chart on the same page.
audit.corrected: Flipped all 7 phases[].side/rating/why to match content win[] and the packet chart (Brand levels 1 through first item, Zilean at 2+ items), and moved diff/tone/diffRating/carryRating/breakdown.difficulty/report[14].t from EVEN to FAVOURED to match. win[] itself was already correct so no content-layer edit was needed there.

audit.why: Content spikes correctly track level 2 (no CC vs Brand), level 6 (Chronoshift blunting the R all-in), and the late-game utility/revive spike — grounded in real kit differences.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, winCon and enemyWin describe a sustain/heal matchup ('their sustain answers chip', 'insurance math', 'healing through your math') — that's Yuumi's archetype, not Zilean's. Zilean has no healing; his defining tool is Chronoshift's revive plus a double-bomb stun, and missingInteractions flags that Chronoshift lets him go untargetable through a commit.
audit.why: The wording is templated from a sustain-enchantress matchup and doesn't describe what Zilean actually does, which misleads a player about what they're playing around.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr/winCon/enemyWin to describe the revive/double-bomb reality instead of sustain.

notes: Major mirror/chart contradiction found and fixed: full layer said EVEN/all-Skill while content win[] and the packet's own levelChart said Brand favored levels 1 through first item and Zilean favored at 2+ items — flipped the full-layer chart (side+rating+why, proposed as one group) and the diff/tone/diffRating/carryRating/breakdown.difficulty/report[14].t to match, since content and packet agreed with each other and full was the outlier. Also found tldr/winCon/enemyWin templated from a sustain-enchantress archetype (identical wording pattern to the Yuumi matchup) that doesn't fit Zilean, who has no sustain — rewrote around his actual revive/double-bomb kit. Fixed both COPY_PASTE_BLEED findings and the COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT finding (added Chronoshift's real 120-60s cooldown).
